name: Fly.io Sprites
description: Run each Orca workspace in its own Sprite, a persistent Linux VM from Fly.io. Adds Sprites under Run on > Per-Workspace Environment.

cover.alt: Sprites for Orca, with the Fly.io logo, beside an illustration of the Fly.io balloon in swim goggles swimming underwater with fish

screenshots.alt: Orca with four workspaces in the sidebar, each running on its own Sprite with its own VM tag and agent status: working, needs you, done
screenshots.caption: One Sprite per workspace

screenshots.alt: Orca plugin directory filtered to Remote/VMs, with the Fly.io Sprites plugin card and its Install & enable button highlighted
screenshots.caption: Install from Orca’s plugin directory

screenshots.alt: Orca new workspace dialog: Run on is set to Sprites, picked from the Per-Workspace Environment menu, with Claude Code as the agent
screenshots.caption: Run on → Sprites

screenshots.alt: Provisioning steps for a Sprites workspace: create Sprite, install Orca, clone repo, start Orca, then ready in under two minutes
screenshots.caption: Provisioning, step by step

screenshots.alt: Orca Settings with the Host menu set to the workspace VM, the Claude accounts section and Add Account highlighted, and the new account active on that VM
screenshots.caption: Sign Claude in on the Sprite

screenshots.alt: Claude Code session in a workspace tagged with its Sprite VM, finishing with 87 tests passed
screenshots.caption: Your agent, on its own VM
